piggybank_village.does: Swings a shopping bag that sucks up your coins.
piggybank_village.effect: Steals 5 coins if you answer wrong.

piggybank_village.does: Dives claws first and snatches coins.
piggybank_village.effect: Hits first if you take longer than 10 seconds.
piggybank_village.lesson: Shiny things tempt you to buy without thinking.

piggybank_village.does: Lunges with chomping jaws and spits coins.
piggybank_village.effect: Eats part of your savings shield.

piggybank_village.does: Rains shopping bags across the whole screen.
piggybank_village.effect: Hits twice in a row on a wrong answer.

second_attack.does: Fires a blinking BUY NOW ray.
second_attack.effect: Shrinks your answer timer for 1 turn.

borrowers_bridges.does: Splits in two and hurls slime blobs with IOU notes.
borrowers_bridges.effect: Splits into 2 slimes if not beaten in 3 turns.
Damage goes up +2 every turn it is ignored.
borrowers_bridges.lesson: Interest grows on top of interest.

borrowers_bridges.does: Slams its stopwatch club and sends out a clock shockwave.
borrowers_bridges.effect: Extra damage if your answer is slow.

borrowers_bridges.does: Cracks a chain whip covered in IOU tags.
borrowers_bridges.effect: Locks one answer button for a turn.

guildworks.does: Tears open a paycheck and coins fly out.
guildworks.effect: Takes a slice of coins you earned this battle.

guildworks.does: Flops down and sends out a Zzz shockwave.
Juggles and throws tools and delivery boxes.
Shoots fireballs made of spinning gears.
guildworks.effect: Gets stronger each turn but loses health too.

second_attack.does: Drops a giant anvil from above.

compound_orchard.does: Dives with its rocket stinger trailing green up arrows.
compound_orchard.lesson: Fear of missing out leads to bad investments.

compound_orchard.does: Inflates its bubble until it bursts.
compound_orchard.effect: Grows for 2 turns, then pops for big damage.

compound_orchard.does: Smashes down a red down-arrow sign.
compound_orchard.effect: Knocks your next spell's power down.

compound_orchard.does: Slams its red-chart branches and drops rotten coin fruit.

second_attack.does: Roots burst out of the ground.

stormwatch_coast.effect: Breaks your shield if you have no insurance spell up.

stormwatch_coast.does: Shoots a rushing water blast with sparks.
stormwatch_coast.lesson: Disasters can wipe out what you have.

stormwatch_coast.does: Summons a tidal wave plus lightning.
stormwatch_coast.effect: Huge hit unless Insurance Barrier is up.

second_attack.does: Spins you around in a whirlpool.

crossroads_observatory.does: Opens a FREE PRIZE box that explodes into hypnotic spirals.
crossroads_observatory.lesson: If it sounds too good to be true, it's a scam.

crossroads_observatory.does: Puffs up and squeezes coins smaller.
crossroads_observatory.effect: Your coins are worth less until it's beaten.

crossroads_observatory.does: Swings question-mark lanterns that confuse you.
crossroads_observatory.effect: Hides one answer choice for a turn.
crossroads_observatory.lesson: Make a plan and stick to it.

crossroads_observatory.does: Fires a star beam from its wings.
crossroads_observatory.effect: Asks a bonus riddle; wrong = double damage.

second_attack.effect: Balances both health bars toward the middle.

sunfire_pass.does: Rolls into a ball of molten gold.
sunfire_pass.effect: Hard to hit; takes half spell damage.

nebula_grove.effect: Sleepy: skip a turn 30% of the time.

nebula_grove.does: Opens a tiny black hole flower.

nebula_grove.effect: Hits harder each time it charges.

astral_ruins.does: Slams the ground and runes light up.
astral_ruins.effect: Shield up for itself next turn.

astral_ruins.does: Bashes with an old star shield.
Dashes past with a blazing comet tail.

moonwell_cavern.does: Washes a ghostly wave over you.
All three heads fire silver beams.
moonwell_cavern.effect: 3 hits; each head can be beaten separately.
